trust_cutoffs_pp.note: Expected error (mean absolute gap, pp) at a new station after kept rules. Below 1.5 = trust it; 1.5 to 3.0 = double-check it; above 3.0 = ask real people. Why 3.0: real Mon-Fri patterns differ by about 2.7 pp between a hybrid-work station and a Bronx station (MTA, Oct 2026), so an error above that means the crowd cannot tell those neighborhoods apart.

skeptic: A rule is kept only if it matches >= 3 training stations, improves >= 3 in leave-one-out, and beats the dumb fix in leave-one-out.
headline: Share of the 4 exam stations whose real error landed inside the band the agent predicted before the exam.
